set.body:
Acceptance criteria
- No executor discards a supplied policy.
- If only direct sequential execution is supported, inert policy parameters and Auto choices are removed before stabilization.
- If policy choices remain, each branch has specified dispatch behavior and direct-versus-reference tests.
- Auto is not public until its selection contract is documented.
- Policy behavior agrees on JVM and Scala.js.
- Documentation contains no placebo performance controls.
set.title: Remove or implement every stencil execution policy option
